description: This source file implements a REST API backend using FastAPI for a notes application. It defines endpoints for user authentication, CRUD operations for notes, and listing folders and tags. The file includes dependencies injection, middleware setup, and route handlers with associated docstrings.

classes.name: SupabaseClient
classes.description: Client interface for interacting with Supabase backend services.

methods.name: register( user: UserRegisterRequest, client: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase_client) )
methods.description: Registers a new user and returns a JWT token response.

methods.name: login( user: UserLoginRequest, client: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase_client) )
methods.description: Logs in a user and returns an access token.

methods.name: list_notes( folder_id: Optional[str] = None, tag_id: Optional[str] = None, search: Optional[str] = None, current_user=Depends(get_current_user), client: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase_client), )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes with optional filtering.

methods.name: create_note( note: NoteCreate, current_user=Depends(get_current_user), client: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase_client), )
methods.description: Creates a new note for the current user.

methods.name: update_note( note_id: str, note: NoteUpdate, current_user=Depends(get_current_user), client: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase_client), )
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by note_id.

methods.name: delete_note( note_id: str, current_user=Depends(get_current_user), client: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase_client), )
get_note( note_id: str, current_user=Depends(get_current_user), client: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase_client), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by note_id.

methods.name: list_folders( current_user=Depends(get_current_user), client: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase_client), )
methods.description: Lists all folders for the current user.

methods.name: list_tags( current_user=Depends(get_current_user), client: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase_client), )
methods.description: Lists all tags for the current user.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning a simple message.
